## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: New module `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py` with `read_ledger(path) -> dict`, `write_ledger(path, ledger)`, `append_cycle(path, cycle_num, findings_tuples, commit_sha, findings_hash, halt_reason=None)`, `reconstruct_from_pr_comments(pr_number, repo) -> dict`. (Tests precede implementation per TDD.)
- DD7: Unit tests for each module: ≥85% branch coverage; explicit tests for each edge case in DD6; tests for atomic-write contention and reconstruction parser tolerance.

## TDD Requirement
Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py`.

Test functions (Given/When/Then):

1. `test_read_ledger_returns_empty_when_file_absent`
   - Given: nonexistent path
   - When: read_ledger(path) called
   - Then: returns {"schema_version": "1.1.0", "epic_id": "", "cycles": []}

2. `test_write_and_read_round_trip_v1_1_0`
   - Given: ledger dict with v1.1.0 schema (cycles with findings tuples, commit_sha)
   - When: write_ledger then read_ledger
   - Then: returned ledger equals written (atomic write + JSON serialization fidelity)

3. `test_append_cycle_increments_cycles_array`
   - Given: existing ledger with 1 cycle
   - When: append_cycle called with cycle_num=2, findings, commit_sha, findings_hash
   - Then: ledger now has 2 cycles; new entry has all fields populated

4. `test_read_v1_0_0_ledger_backward_compat`
   - Given: ledger file with schema_version="1.0.0" (no findings/commit_sha fields in cycles)
   - When: read_ledger called
   - Then: returns ledger with v1.0.0 cycles intact (no crash); missing fields default sensibly

5. `test_reconstruct_from_pr_comments_parses_extended_marker`
   - Given: mocked PR comments containing "DSO-Review-Cycle: 1 commit_sha=abc123 findings_hash=h1 tuples=[[\"f.py\",\"10-20\",\"correctness\"]]"
   - When: reconstruct_from_pr_comments(pr_number, repo) called
   - Then: returns ledger with cycle 1 containing all parsed fields including findings tuple

6. `test_reconstruct_tolerates_legacy_marker_format`
   - Given: PR comment with old format "DSO-Review-Cycle: 1 findings-hash=h1" (no tuples/commit_sha)
   - When: reconstruct called
   - Then: cycle entry produced without findings/commit_sha (graceful degradation, no crash)

7. `test_reconstruct_malformed_marker_logged_skipped`
   - Given: PR comment with malformed marker "DSO-Review-Cycle: not-a-number ..."
   - When: reconstruct called
   - Then: malformed entry skipped, warning logged to stderr, other valid entries still parsed

8. `test_append_atomic_under_concurrent_write_simulation`
   - Given: ledger file + simulated concurrent writer (acquire lock externally)
   - When: append_cycle called
   - Then: blocks until lock released; final ledger has both appends in correct order

All tests MUST FAIL (RED) before T3 implementation runs. Update `.test-index` with RED marker.

## Implementation Notes
- Test file: `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py`
- Import target: `from dso_ci_review.cycle_ledger import read_ledger, write_ledger, append_cycle, reconstruct_from_pr_comments`
- Mock `gh api` calls via subprocess.run patch for reconstruct tests
- Use tmp_path fixture for ledger files
- Reuse lock pattern from write-cycle-ledger.sh for atomic-write test

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test_cycle_ledger.py exists with all 8 test functions
  Verify: grep -c "^def test_" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py | awk '{exit (\$1 < 8)}'
- [ ] All 8 tests FAIL (RED) before T3 implementation
  Verify: python -m pytest $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py 2>&1 | grep -qE "8 (errors|failed)|ModuleNotFoundError"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for cycle_ledger.py
  Verify: grep "test_read_ledger_returns_empty_when_file_absent\|cycle_ledger" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
